integrity: Symbolic all-integer proof by Parseval and strict power-simplex concavity; a stand-alone exact-arithmetic checker reproduces finite collision and sharp-ratio cases but is not an infinite certificate. The closest published all-even-moment phase formula is acknowledged as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Three nonzero frequency coefficients on the one-dimensional torus, known coefficient magnitudes for quadrature inversion, and a controlled phase modulation of the middle coefficient. Other sensing designs or statistical noise models are not covered. The primitive Fourier collision mechanism is established prior work.
title: Optimal amplitude allocation for first resonant Fourier-phase measurements
